regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. I have somany messages from you unanswered that I am now determined before postponing more to thank you at least. I hope this finds you improved and improv- ing . . . . I have just a few minutes . . · The picture I am sending under separate cover was quite ideal, but some one had and accident and broke the glass. The little frame just fits where I want it . I hope you will like the Placque . etc.
